title_vi: CDN cho người mới: máy chủ biên, điện toán biên và chơi game trên mây

related.reason_vi: Bài CDN phổ biến vì đâu giải thích lời dặn Cache-Control quyết định máy biên lưu gì.

claims.evidence: MDN's CDN glossary entry and RFC 9111 read from local clones; nginx 1.24.0 measured in front of a Python origin delayed by 200 ms. Edge computing and cloud gaming are explained from the author's reasoning, not checked against a platform's documentation.

claims.claim_vi: A CDN is a group of servers in many locations holding duplicate copies of data so requests are served by the server closest to the user; geographical distance affects latency.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content at commit a1aa79c09717761fc72c20bac94bb9c430ed487a, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: Downsides of a third-party CDN: an extra dependency that can go down, be blocked or shut down; an extra attack vector; possibly worse performance because of extra DNS lookups and connection set-up, and browsers do not share cache across origins.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content at commit a1aa79c09717761fc72c20bac94bb9c430ed487a, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: The private response directive forbids a shared cache from storing the response.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of httpwg/httpwg.github.io at commit 03f35d852e7b64668ab08fda1a8076d6d44d17ae, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: With a Python origin sleeping 200 ms per response behind nginx 1.24.0 proxy_cache, ten requests each: public, max-age=60 took 204 ms first (MISS) then a median of 0.3 ms (HIT), origin hit once; private, max-age=60 was a MISS every time with a median of 202 ms, origin hit ten times.
claims.verified_by: Experiment run by the author on 2026-10-18 on one virtual machine: origin and nginx on the same machine; times measured with Python urllib with proxies disabled. The 200 ms is a simulated delay, not a network measurement.

claims.claim_vi: Edge computing runs code near the user for responses that differ per user; cloud gaming renders frames on a server and streams them, so nothing can be cached and only distance and network quality help.
claims.verified_by: Author's reasoning from the source's three topics; not checked against an edge platform's or a cloud gaming service's documentation.

claims.claim_vi: Edge servers sit closer to users; edge computing processes data closer to the end user; cloud gaming uses cloud computing for low-latency games.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

design_notes_vi: Ba thẻ cạnh nhau cho ba nghĩa của chữ biên, không có mũi tên vì chúng không nối tiếp nhau; một khung cái giá lấy từ MDN.
source_deviations: Source presents the three technologies as jointly making experiences faster; the lesson contrasts what each brings closer and why caching does not help the last two.
The lesson adds an nginx experiment and MDN's downsides of CDNs.
